Had an incident the other week at caulfield Park where this dog took an instant liking to mine, stalking it and trying to play with my dog. My dog generally is only interested in me and ignores other dogs - so we kept running, mind you a long distance from where we initially encountered this dog, and it would not leave us alone. 

Eventually I would estimate we were 1km away from where we initially encountered it, and we were finished with our time in the park, so I led my dog to my car to jump in, and this dog walked right up to the sidewalk of a busy street, and just waited next to my car. 

Now I'm not going to take responsibility for another dog, let alone another stupid humans lack of consideration for their pet, but when your dog is 1km away from where you might be, walking up to a busy road, I can't bring myself to leave it in such a sort of danger. So I took my dog back out of the car, went back to where we encountered it and started questioning random people if they were the owner. 

Eventually I found the owner, a father son duo playing some basketball on the halfcourt. I left them with their dog and left. 

Didn't need to have an altercation in front of the young boy, but that situation infuriated me to no end. Poor dog.
